other_reading: The PDF should be saved to a different folder or under a different file name than the source document, or the request means the PDF replaces the .docx as the saved file.
reading_followed: A new PDF named Meeting-Agenda.pdf is created beside Meeting-Agenda.docx on the Desktop, and the .docx is left unchanged.
notes: The request names no location or file name, so the same-folder, same-base-name copy was chosen as the default. The reader cannot read PDF text, so PDF content is covered only by a fuzzy criterion.
